job.title: Practice Manager
job.description:
Our client is seeking an enthusiastic and skilled Practice Manager to join our team in Lakewood. This is a full-time, Monday to Friday position—no nights or weekends!


If you're passionate about providing an exceptional patient experience and want to be part of a workplace that values both employees and patients, we want to hear from you! We’re looking for a motivated, positive professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to advance their career while leading a dedicated team. As our Practice Manager, you'll oversee the day-to-day operations, ensuring outstanding customer service and a smooth-running office while inspiring your team to achieve excellence.


This Role Is Perfect For Someone Who


  • Enjoys staying active and managing a busy environment
  • Thrives in a fast-paced, challenging setting
  • Communicates effectively with patients, dentists, and staff
  • Is proactive, detail-oriented, and solution-focused
  • Is eager to be part of a positive, collaborative team

Requirements


  • Proven experience in a dental managerial role
  • Strong time and schedule management skills
  • Exceptional interpersonal and customer service abilities
  • Proficient in computer systems and office software
  • Alignment with our core values of Integrity, Commitment to Excellence, and Loyalty

Benefits


  • Competitive salary starting at $75,000 annually, with potential for higher earnings based on experience, plus performance-based incentives.
  • 100% company-paid insurance for you, plus options to add family or upgrade your plan.
  • Enjoy a healthy work-life balance with generous paid time off and 9 paid holidays.
  • Plan for your future with a strong 401(k) and company match.
  • Dental coverage kicks in on day one for you and your immediate family.
  • Celebrate wins big and small through our peer recognition program.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career and lead a team focused on excellence, apply today!
